The Vols tied it with a 32-yard field goal, then cornerback Dejuan Lane returned an interception 41 yards for a touchdown, followed by Brandon's 20-yard strike to Braylon Staley for a 24-10 halftime edge. Tennessee outgained Georgia Tech 212-150 yards, with Vols fans turning Atlanta's Bobby Dodd Stadium into an orange sea of noise.

2098917237516116239.name: North Texas Crushes UNLV 41-6, Ends Playoff Hopes
2098917237516116239.summary: North Texas dominated UNLV 41-6 on Saturday in Denton, Texas, with quarterback Tayven Jackson and running back Jaheim White powering the Mean Green to victory. The Rebels managed only two field goals, committed three turnovers, and totaled 257 yards, getting eliminated from College Football Playoff contention despite entering at 1-1. Observers like JT The Brick called the performance 'incredibly awful,' while fans vented disappointment over the lopsided loss and offensive struggles.

2098841689893089327.summary: The Flames improved to 1-1 with a tense 24-23 victory over 0-3 Gardner-Webb, an FCS team playing without a head coach, at Williams Stadium on Saturday. Liberty jumped to a 14-3 lead early but trailed 20-17 at halftime after Gardner-Webb's fumble return TD and long rush. Henderson's late strike to Darius Copeland sealed it, marking Liberty's first win since November 1, 2025, though the close call fueled fan concerns about the program's direction under coach Jamey Chadwell.

2098869906250846695.name: Alabama Rallies from 17-13 Deficit to Crush Kentucky 45-17
2098869906250846695.summary: No. 12 Alabama overcame a 17-13 halftime hole against Kentucky, dominating the second half with three straight scores in the third quarter to pull away for a 45-17 victory. Running back Daniel Hill rushed for 104 yards and a touchdown, while quarterback Keelon Russell passed for 188 yards and a score; Kentucky's offense mustered just 62 yards after the break. The win boosted Alabama to 2-0 overall and 1-0 in the SEC, extending their streak of conference opening victories.

2098903313563746788.name: Blue Jackets Fans Frustrated as Fantilli Contract Talks Stall Before Camp
2098903313563746788.summary: The Columbus Blue Jackets' talks with 21-year-old restricted free agent Adam Fantilli have stalled, even as camp opens Wednesday and practices start Thursday. The No. 3 pick from 2023 tallied 24 goals and 35 assists last season as the team's top center, but his side is holding firm amid big extensions for peers like Leo Carlsson and Connor Bedard. Fans are criticizing the front office online for risking a holdout, though most expect a deal eventually amid rising salaries for young stars.
